name: ProLiant Compute DL380 Gen12 2U server
source: HPE ProLiant Compute DL380 Gen12 QuickSpecs
notes: 2U two-socket Intel Xeon 6 server, iLO 7. No built-in NIC: ports come from the OCP 3.0 (A standard, B optional) and PCIe cards fitted. Up to 8 PCIe Gen5 slots (6 x16 + 2 x8). Optional front DisplayPort and 2 x USB 2.0 via the Universal Media Bay; optional rear serial port. 1 or 2 Flex Slot PSUs 800-2200 W (1600 W and up need 200-240 V). Add NIC, GPU, HBA and SDI card ports as extra ports for the cards fitted.

name: ProLiant Compute DL360 Gen12 1U server
source: HPE ProLiant Compute DL360 Gen12 product page
notes: 1U two-socket Intel Xeon 6 server, iLO 7. No built-in NIC: ports come from the OCP 3.0 and PCIe cards fitted. Check: PCIe slot count (3 assumed, as on the Gen11) and front ports (taken from the DL380 Gen12). Add NIC, GPU, HBA and SDI card ports as extra ports for the cards fitted.

name: ProLiant DL360 Gen11 1U server
notes: 1U two-socket 4th/5th gen Intel Xeon server, iLO 6. No built-in NIC: ports come from the OCP 3.0 (slot 2 needs CPU 2) and PCIe cards (2 standard, slot 3 needs CPU 2). Pre-configured models often carry a 4 x 1GbE BCM5719 OCP3 or 2 x 10GBASE-T BCM57416 card. Optional front DisplayPort (not active together with the rear VGA) and front USB 2.0; optional rear serial port. Flex Slot hot-plug PSUs: 500/800/1000 W take C13/C14 cords; 1600 W runs on 200-240 V only; Check: the inlet on 1800-2200 W Titanium supplies. Check: iLO service port connector (micro-USB assumed; Gen12 uses USB-C). Add NIC, GPU, HBA and SDI card ports as extra ports for the cards fitted.

name: ProLiant DL380 Gen11 2U server
notes: 2U two-socket 4th/5th gen Intel Xeon server, iLO 6. No built-in NIC: ports come from the OCP 3.0 and PCIe cards fitted. Up to 8 PCIe slots (3 primary, 3 secondary, 2 tertiary riser). Optional front DisplayPort and USB 2.0 via the Universal Media Bay; optional rear serial port. A common host for broadcast software (playout, graphics, MAM). Flex Slot hot-plug PSUs: 500/800/1000 W take C13/C14 cords; 1600 W runs on 200-240 V only; Check: the inlet on 1800-2200 W Titanium supplies. Check: iLO service port connector (micro-USB assumed; Gen12 uses USB-C). Add NIC, GPU, HBA and SDI card ports as extra ports for the cards fitted.

name: ProLiant DL20 Gen11 1U short-depth server
notes: Short-depth 1U single-socket Intel Xeon E-2400 server, 378 mm deep (SFF). 4 x 1GbE BCM5719 embedded; NIC 1 is shared with iLO. A dedicated iLO port and serial port come with the LP Serial/iLO/M.2 enablement kit (P65407-B21). Standard 290 W non-hot-plug PSU; redundant Flex Slot PSUs (500/800/1000 W) optional, so change the PSU count to 2 if fitted.

name: MSA 2062 16Gb FC SFF storage array (24 x 2.5 in)
notes: 2U array with two controllers; each controller has 4 host ports, 1 SAS expansion port (mini-SAS HD), 1 RJ45 management port and a CLI port, and the enclosure has 2 hot-plug PSUs. Up to 9 expansion enclosures. Check: CLI port connector and PSU inlet. 24 SFF bays, 2 x 16Gb FC 4-port controllers. MSA 2062 is the 2060 bundled with two SSDs and the advanced data services licence. 508 mm deep.
